opportunities.hypothesis: Collapse repeated sub-10-us kernels only when a producer-consumer boundary can be removed without changing graph semantics.
opportunities.name: Compact repeated short decode kernels
observations: A reachable SM89 batch-1 fusion combined SwiGLU activation with the down-projection GEMV. Its CUDA Graph microbenchmark improved from 45.169 us to 26.522 us (1.703x), but C-S-S-C whole-model validation improved E2E by only 1.016x and TPOT by only 1.014x.

The fused reduction was deterministic within mode but diverged from stock greedy output in 2/6 natural cases by token 64. Reject this activation+down boundary implementation: it misses the 1.03x promotion floor and the strict token-equivalence contract.

The measured whole-step saving was about 0.114 ms/token versus a 0.448 ms/token sum-of-layer microbenchmark projection, a 25% transfer ratio. Future graph-compaction candidates must model overlap and graph replay before integration.

opportunities.derivation: Nsight observes 21,204 cuBLAS GEMV launches over 186 decode steps (5.036 ms/step), but source-level dataflow audit shows that vLLM already fuses nearly every dependency-free projection group. The remaining legal QKVZ+BA fusion was exact on all six cheap-screen requests yet regressed TPOT by 5.7%, leaving only higher-risk persistent or segmented schedules with a much smaller likely interval.

Source-bound mathematical dependencies, already-fused regions and the one remaining dependency-free projection pair.

opportunities.hypothesis: A segmented persistent schedule may remove projection launch overhead without changing the tile-friendly 8192-row QKVZ schedule that the simple concatenation prototype damaged.
opportunities.name: Fuse or persist batch-1 decode projections
observations: The segmented QKVZ+BA Triton prototype was observed exactly 3,348 times by Nsight and reduced projection launches from 36 to 18 per decode step.
Standalone C-S-S-C delivered 1.036x E2E and 1.040x TPOT over the lm_head baseline, while direct stock-to-combined C-S-S-C delivered 1.190x E2E and 1.200x TPOT.
The candidate is deterministic within mode but only 3/6 token-exact against stock at 64 tokens.

A deterministic 512-example official GSM8K screen scored control 47/512 and candidate 46/512; paired McNemar p=1.0 found no detectable regression, so the candidate clears a limited task-quality gate but not broad production qualification.

evidence.claim: Hash-bound closure of the current SM89 BF16 recurrent-state search budget across schedule and ownership rewrites.

closure.reason: Bounded schedule, generic reuse, serial ownership, and four-warp parallel ownership all fail strict-state or CUDA-Graph materiality gates on SM89 BF16.
reopen_conditions: A warp-specialized CUDA13 toolchain preserves stock BV32 layout and exact head-wide reduction.
A convolution-recurrence or persistent-state design predicts at least 50 us whole-step gain without duplicated q/k work.
The model shape, state dtype, GPU architecture, or CUDA Graph contract changes.

opportunities.derivation: The recurrent kernel alone consumes 0.306 ms/decode step in the expanded CUDA graph; the ceiling leaves mandatory recurrence work intact and treats only state traffic and neighboring launch overhead as removable.

evidence.claim: Per-family GPU-active time for recurrent decode and neighboring kernels.
Production-BF16-state warm sweep and 64 MiB cold-cache paired replay of the existing packed recurrent schedule family.
Bounded BF16-state multiwarp ownership screen across 18 BV/warp/stage configurations.
Bitwise-exact architecture screen of one-program-per-head recurrence plus gated RMSNorm under CUDA Graph replay and cache eviction.

opportunities.hypothesis: Keep recurrent state in the consumer layout and fuse adjacent transforms to remove round trips and small launches.
opportunities.name: Reduce recurrent-state materialization
observations: The prior isolated launch sweep used FP32 state, while this BF16 model's auto SSM cache is BF16; the production-dtype screen corrects that mismatch.
BV64/one-warp/four-stage was only 1.062x in the warm BF16-state sweep, projecting 33.9 us per whole step, below the 50 us residual materiality floor.
With 64 MiB eviction and alternating order, the same schedule was 0.750x; the earlier reachable full-model candidate was also only 0.903x despite 6/6 token exactness.
All 18 BF16-state BV64/BV128 multiwarp points preserved the immediate output but changed recurrent state by up to 2.98e-8, so they fail the strict state-transition contract before timing promotion.
Close launch-geometry retuning. Keep this opportunity open only for a producer-consumer or state-layout rewrite that predicts at least 50 us per whole step.

A bitwise-exact one-program-per-head recurrence+gated-RMSNorm fusion removed a launch and shared q/k loads, but CUDA Graph replay regressed from 16.398 us to 21.967 us (0.747x) because it serialized four BV32 tiles. Close this ownership design; any successor must preserve tile parallelism.
